Command without effect, for internal use only
Switch point 1, [SP1] shall be greater than [rP1]. Please consider to the actual [rP1] value. If the [SP1] will be set below [rP1] it will be refused. [SP] = [FH] and [rP] = [FL] if [OU1] = Fno, Fnc.
Reset point 1, [rP1] shall be smaller than [SP1]. Please consider to the actual [SP1] value. If the [rP1] will be set above [SP1] it will be refused. [rP] = [FL] and [SP] = [FH] if [OU1] = Fno, Fnc.

Time delay for [SP1] / window. If the system pressure exceeds [SP1] or if the system pressure enters the acceptable range (window), the output changes the switching status when the time [dS1] has elapsed.

Time delay for [rP1] / window. If the system pressure falls below [rP1] or if the system pressure leaves the acceptable range (window), the output changes the switching status when the time [dr1] has elapsed.
Selection of unit on the sensor display
Response time between process value change and change of the switching output
Colour of the digital display (permanent or alternating with switching status [OUT1]).
r-on / The colour of the display changes from green to red if [OUT1] is switched
G-on / The colour of the display changes from red to green if [OUT1] is switched
rEd / The colour of the display is red, does not change
GrEn / The colour of the display is green, does not change
[Loc] locks the local user interface to prevent unintentional changes, [Loc] is resettable at the device
